name: Hen'ai Necromanticism
original_name: 偏愛ネクロマンチシズム
source:
In a certain location in Tokyo, where thefts of corpses were rampant, one morning, Minazuki, an employee of a funeral company, arrived at the funeral home to find that the body that should have been in the coffin had disappeared. In its place was an unfamiliar, beautiful doll-like corpse. Enthralled by the scent of death, Minazuki, who had an attachment to death, immediately became captivated by the corpse, adoring and cherishing it. However, what appeared to be a corpse actually began to move—

A tale connecting humans and vampires, seeking eternity, rejecting it, and shattering it. Time, stand still. The woman is beautiful.

[From [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/17144/article/790993]Ci-en[/url]]
translation:
在偷尸事件猖獗的东京某地，一天早上，殡仪公司员工水无月来到殡仪馆，发现本应放在棺材里的尸体不见了。取而代之的是一具陌生的、美丽的娃娃般的尸体。被死亡的气息所吸引，对死亡有执着的水无月立刻就对尸体着了迷，对它产生了崇拜和珍惜。然而，看似尸体的东西却开始动了——

一个连接人类和吸血鬼、寻求永恒、拒绝它、粉碎它的故事。时间，静止。女人很漂亮。

[来自[url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/17144/article/790993]Ci-en[/url]]
